message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to make a hearty, traditional lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9‑x‑13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat** | Ground beef (80/20) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| **Vegetables** | Onion (finely chopped) | 1 medium (≈150 g) |
| | Garlic cloves (minced) | 3–4 cloves |
| | Carrot (finely grated) | ½ cup (≈75 g) |
| | Celery stalk (finely diced) | ½ cup (≈75 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp (≈30 g) |
| | Crushed tomatoes or passata | 1½–2 cups (≈360–480 ml) |
| | Fresh basil leaves (chopped) | ¼ cup (≈10 g) |
| | Oregano (dried) | 1 tsp (≈2 g) |
| | Salt | 1 tsp (≈5 g) |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp (≈2 g) |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp (≈1 g) |
| **Cheese** | Ricotta cheese | 1½–2 cups (≈360–480 g) |
| | Mozzarella (shredded) | 2–3 cups (≈200–300 g) |
| | Parmesan (grated) | ½–¾ cup (≈50–75 g) |
| | Pecorino Romano (optional, grated) | ¼ cup (≈25 g) |
| **Dairy** | Heavy cream (optional, for richer sauce) | ¼ cup (≈60 ml) |
| **Herbs & Seasonings** | Fresh parsley (chopped) | 2 Tbsp (≈10 g) |
| | Bay leaf | 1–2 leaves |
| | Italian seasoning blend | 1 tsp (≈2 g) |
| **Miscellaneous** | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp (≈30 ml) |
| | Butter (for greasing the baking dish) | 2 Tbsp (≈30 g) |
| | Egg (for binding ricotta mixture, optional) | 1 large (≈50 g) |

### Optional Add‑Ons
- **Spinach** (fresh or frozen, sautéed and drained) – 1–2 cups (≈100–200 g)
- **Mushrooms** (sliced, sautéed) – 1 cup (≈70 g)
- **Sausage** (Italian sausage, crumbled) – ½–1 lb (≈225–450 g)
- **Béchamel sauce** (butter, flour, milk) – 1–2 cups (≈240–480 ml)

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your taste preferences or the number of servings you’re aiming for. Enjoy your lasagna!
